1.pickthall: Say: He is Allah, the One!
1.yusuf_ali: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only;
1.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)): "He is Allah, (the) One.

2.pickthall: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
2.shakir: Allah is He on Whom all depend.
2.mohsin_khan: "Allah-us-Samad (The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He neither eats nor drinks).

3.sahih_international: He neither begets nor is born,
3.pickthall: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
3.yusuf_ali: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;
3.shakir: He begets not, nor is He begotten.
3.muhammad_sarwar: He neither begets nor was He begotten.
3.mohsin_khan: "He begets not, nor was He begotten;
3.arberry: who has not begotten, and has not been begotten,

4.sahih_international: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
4.pickthall: And there is none comparable unto Him.
4.yusuf_ali: And there is none like unto Him.
4.muhammad_sarwar: There is no one equal to Him.
4.mohsin_khan: "And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him."
4.arberry: and equal to Him is not any one.'
